changes: Payroll uses one Save & Close Payroll action and stays in Entries, with Salary History retained.
Payroll journal keeps Prepare in Transactions and Post to Active Journal, saves the layout with either action and confirms payroll without opening the full sync window.
Device-copy confirmation notices appear only in the compact editor status area, including when reopening older payroll reports.
Payroll attendance explanations use a formal Attendance basis note, including saved report copies.
Data Check now reviews every posted journal through month-end, foreign rates and LAK mappings, and recorded exchange gain/loss.
Amortization and recurring checks include due items, monthly/daily allocations, historical values, year carryover and linked postings.
Closing reruns mandatory checks; arithmetic errors block closing and review items require an explanation. No financial records are changed by checking.
